applies_to: SINAMICS G120 / G120P inverters with the CU230P-2 HVAC control unit using its RS-485 port for BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The CU230P-2 HVAC control unit (used on G120P drives) has native BACnet MS/TP on its RS-485 terminals, selected with p2030 = 5. It exposes digital input and relay status, relay commands, run/stop, direction, reset, hibernation and override bits, plus analog values for frequency, speed, current, power, energy and fault and alarm history. This list comes from the firmware 4.3 manual; later firmware may add objects.
notes: Device instance is p2025[0] (factory setting 1); baud rate is p2020 (default 9600).
Command objects only act when command source p0700 and setpoint source p1000 are set to fieldbus.
The factory fieldbus monitoring time p2040 (100 ms) is usually too short for BACnet and should be raised.
Text active/inactive columns in the source look swapped on several BVs; states here use the 'possible values' column.
The manual describes AV29 as 'Signal from AO 1'; it is the AO 2 readback and is described that way here.
Source is the 02/2010 edition for FW 4.3; check against the manual for your firmware.

source.title: SINAMICS G120 Control Units CU230P-2 Operating Instructions

integration.summary: Set p2030 = 5 (BACnet), give the drive a MAC address by DIP switch or p2021, set baud p2020 and device instance p2025[0], then set p0700 = 6 and p1000 = 6 so commands and setpoint come from the fieldbus. Write BV20 RUN/STOP CMD and AV17 FREQ STPT PCT, read BV0, BV2 and AV0/AV5/AV7, and reset with BV22. Raise p2040 from its 100 ms factory value.

minimum_points.name: RUN ENA CMD
minimum_points.why: Enable operation (control word bit 3); must be on to run

integration.enable: p0700 = 6 (via fieldbus) selects BACnet as the command source and p1000 = 6 the setpoint source. BV93 CTL OVERRIDE CMD moves inverter control to BACnet override; the operator panel's Manual mode still has priority. BV26 RUN ENA CMD enables operation and BV24 CDS switches local/remote.
integration.heartbeat: p2040 Fieldbus monitoring time (0-65535000 ms, factory 100 ms) is the comms watchdog; Siemens notes 100 ms is probably too short for BACnet and must be raised. The BACnet section does not say what the drive does when it expires.
setup: MS/TP MAC (1-127) comes from the Control Unit DIP switches, or p2021 when all address switches are off; a change needs a full power-off including any external 24 V.
p2025[0] device instance (factory 1), [1] max info frames (1), [2] APDU retries (3), [3] max master (127).
p2026 sets COV increments for AI0, AI1, AI10 and AI11 (factory 0.100); up to 32 COV subscriptions.
gotchas: Panel Manual mode beats BACnet override control.
AV16 RPM STPT 1, AV30-AV33 and AV12 write drive parameters directly.
This list comes from the FW 4.3 manual; newer firmware may differ.
